findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in protobuf
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("loads").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization operations (pickle, yaml, marshal, shelve, json) that could lead to arbitrary code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Direct eval/exec usage
 * @description Direct usage of eval or exec functions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/direct-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
select call, "Direct use of eval, exec, or compile which can lead to code injection."
findings.hypothesis: Direct usage of eval/exec/compile functions in the codebase

message.text: Direct use of eval, exec, or compile which can lead to code injection.
